checks.name: machine-phi-survives-isel
checks.observed:
bb.0.entry:
    successors: %bb.1(0x40000000), %bb.2(0x40000000)
    liveins: $r1, $r2, $r3
  
    %5:gpr = COPY $r3
    %4:gpr = COPY $r2
    %3:gpr = COPY $r1
    %6:gpr = AND_ri %3, 1
    JEQ_ri killed %6, 0, %bb.2
    JMP %bb.1
  
  bb.1.yes:
    successors: %bb.3(0x80000000)
  
    %0:gpr = LDD %4, 0 :: (volatile load (s64) from %ir.p)
    JMP %bb.3
  
  bb.2.no:
    successors: %bb.3(0x80000000)
  
    %1:gpr = LDD %5, 0 :: (volatile load (s64) from %ir.q)
    JMP %bb.3
  
  bb.3.join:
    %2:gpr = PHI %1, %bb.2, %0, %bb.1
    $r0 = COPY %2
    RET implicit $r0

checks.name: caller-i32-object
checks.observed:
bb.0.entry:
    %0:gpr = MOV_ri 1
    STD killed %0, %stack.0.d, 0 :: (store (s64) into %ir.d)
    %1:gpr = MOV_ri 2
    STD killed %1, %stack.1.e, 0 :: (store (s64) into %ir.e)
    %2:gpr = LDD %stack.0.d, 0 :: (dereferenceable load (s64) from %ir.d)
    %3:gpr = LDD %stack.1.e, 0 :: (dereferenceable load (s64) from %ir.e)
    ADJCALLSTACKDOWN 0, 0, implicit-def dead $r11, implicit $r11
    $r1 = COPY %2
    $r2 = COPY %3
    JAL @callee, implicit-def $r0, implicit-def dead $r1, implicit-def dead $r2, implicit-def dead $r3, implicit-def dead $r4, implicit-def dead $r5, implicit $r11, implicit $r1, implicit $r2
    ADJCALLSTACKUP 0, 0, implicit-def dead $r11, implicit $r11
    %4:gpr = COPY $r0
    STW %4, %stack.2.f, 0 :: (store (s32) into %ir.f)
    %5:gpr = LDW %stack.2.f, 0 :: (dereferenceable load (s32) from %ir.f)
    $r0 = COPY %5
    RET implicit $r0

checks.name: i128-two-halves
checks.observed:
bb.0.entry:
    successors: %bb.1(0x40000000), %bb.2(0x40000000)
    liveins: $r1, $r2, $r3
  
    %2:gpr = COPY $r3
    %1:gpr = COPY $r2
    %0:gpr = COPY $r1
    %3:gpr = LDD %2, 0 :: (load (s64) from %ir.q)
    %4:gpr = LDD %1, 0 :: (load (s64) from %ir.p)
    %5:gpr = ADD_rr %4, killed %3
    %6:gpr = MOV_ri 0
    %7:gpr = MOV_ri 1
    JUGT_rr %4, %5, %bb.2
  
  bb.1.entry:
    successors: %bb.2(0x80000000)
  
  
  bb.2.entry:
    %8:gpr = PHI %6, %bb.1, %7, %bb.0
    %9:gpr = LDD %2, 8 :: (load (s64) from %ir.q + 8)
    %10:gpr = LDD %1, 8 :: (load (s64) from %ir.p + 8)
    STD %5, %0, 0 :: (store (s64) into %ir.dst)
    %11:gpr = ADD_rr %10, killed %9
    %12:gpr = ADD_rr %11, killed %8
    STD killed %12, %0, 8 :: (store (s64) into %ir.dst + 8)
    RET
